partition.apply: sudo -n iptables -I OUTPUT -p tcp --dport $(cat "$CHAOS_ROOT/gateway.port") -m comment --comment cua-chaos -j DROP
partition.undo: sudo -n iptables -D OUTPUT -p tcp --dport $(cat "$CHAOS_ROOT/gateway.port") -m comment --comment cua-chaos -j DROP || true

partition_heal.apply: sudo -n iptables -D OUTPUT -p tcp --dport $(cat "$CHAOS_ROOT/gateway.port") -m comment --comment cua-chaos -j DROP; true

disk_full.apply: bash "$CHAOS_ROOT/space.exec" 'dd if=/dev/zero of=/var/tmp/fill bs=1M count=6000 2>/dev/null || true'

host_loss.apply: touch "$CHAOS_ROOT/host_loss.trigger"; for i in $(seq 120); do [ -e "$CHAOS_ROOT/host_loss.done" ] && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1
